name: Summer Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Do a paid 5-week summer internship and job readiness workshops. Each participant gets a counselor.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 21. The page lists no other rules.
pay_detail: Paid for 110 hours of work and job readiness workshops. Hourly rate not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No dates posted as of Nov 4, 2026. The page says to email for current dates.
how_to_apply: The page has no application form. Email youthservices@gphxul.org to ask about dates, rules and open spots.
notes: The only session named on the page is 2026, in its employer section. Email to confirm the next cycle.
